Hi Ethan / Greenline onboarding team,

Thanks for starting the vendor setup — we're almost there. Before we can issue a PO we need two items to satisfy our finance KYC: a completed W-9 (or W-8BEN-E for non-US entities) and a liveness/bank corroboration. The standard evidence we accept is either:

- a notarized W-9 (signed and stamped), or
- a bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account ownership (dated within 90 days) + a government ID scan of the signer, or
- a certified digital signature plus a bank account micro-deposit confirmation (rare).

You previously attached a W-9 draft in the portal but the signer name on the form doesn't match the payee legal name in our onboarding record (Greenline Health Solutions LLC vs Greenline Health). Can you:

1) Confirm the legal payee name you want on the PO.
2) Re-upload a notarized W-9 or an equivalent bank letter + signer's photo ID.

Per procurement policy, the PO will remain in "ON HOLD - TAX REVIEW" status until we have one of the acceptable evidentiary items. If you can provide it within 48 hours we can evaluate a conditional release (see Jordan's suggested escrow path below).

Attachments: none yet (please upload to the portal or reply with attachments).

Thanks,

Ethan — thanks for the quick turnaround. I reviewed the attached W-9. Two items to flag:

1) Payee name mismatch: The form lists "Greenline Health" but your onboarding record includes a secondary alias. We need the W-9 legal name to exactly match the name on the vendor portal entry or for you to confirm which legal name you want us to use (we can update the portal once we receive confirmation + corrected tax form).

2) Liveness/evidentiary requirement: A scanned, unsigned or unsigned scanned W-9 is not sufficient for automatic PO issuance per our finance policy. For vendor > $50k/year spend or first-time vendors we require one of the evidence items listed earlier (notarized W-9 or bank letter + ID).

Options to proceed quickly:
- Best case: Send a notarized W-9 (PDF) and we'll clear the PO gate immediately after finance sign-off.
- Alternate (faster): Provide a bank letter on letterhead plus a front-photo of the signer's government ID; procurement can propose a conditional PO with 20% held in escrow until final verification.

Jordan — looping you in to propose the conditional PO / escrow mechanics if Greenline wants to avoid notarization delays.

Kimberly
